title.narrative: “Activating and scaling up the women mediators model in Palestine” Phase II
“Activating and scaling up the women mediators model in Palestine” Phase II

description.narrative: Taawon FLC Project Phase II “Activating and scaling up the women mediators model in Palestine” empower women champions to lead interventions and advocacy that ultimately increase their participation in national efforts for UN Resolution 1325 Women, Peace and Security. The project will be implemented in 12 months duration, it contributes to strengthen the enabling environment for women and youth and empower them to participate in political decision-making and social life, in the most conflict affected and marginalized areas in East Jerusalem (Shufat), and in Hebron (Yatta-village, old city-H2 area, Samu’ and Dura). Consequently, Women will play a more meaningful role in conflict prevention, mediation and peacebuilding by strengthening the role of women mediators in conflict resolution and prevention, as well as the role of the Women Led Conflict Prevention Units (WLCPU) in addressing conflict prevention and conflict resolution interventions, and scaling up the model of WLCPU in other communities in Palestine. Our Phase I joint project with Taawon started in September 2019.
